addon:addon.name: Signal Binding
addon:addon.description: This binding handles a connection to the Signal network.

parameter.name: kind
parameter.description: Signal-cli integration mode: Managed (let the binding handle the CLI download/install), Local (you provide the binary path), or network mode (TCP)
parameter.label: Kind Of Signal-cli Integration

parameter.name: configuration
parameter.description: If Kind is "Network", then put here the network url (host:port). If kind is "Local", put the full path to the signal-cli binary, if "Managed", put the version wanted or let empty. For Local and Managed, you can add suffix key/value pairs as environment variables.
parameter.label: Kind-Related Configuration Parameter
